title: Pullman's conservatory arch gains its transoms and low palms
items: The great arched glass front of Pullman's conservatory at 1800 Calumet Avenue is now crossed by two heavy white transoms, as the 1894 Inland Architect plate and Lowe's photograph both draw them. They divide the arch into three tiers of lights instead of one run of thin bars.
Three low palms now stand just inside the north glass, so the arch's lowest tier is planted as the pictures show it. That tier still reads a little lighter than either picture.
